name: The First Night
about: The opening quest line for a new game (scripts/first_night.gd glues it to the rest of the game). Every step can be skipped from the quest log.

steps.text: It's evening in Stars Hollow, and someone's knocking! Say hi to Nina outside, then go and meet the town.
checklist: Talk to Nina, outside your house
Meet Mr. Palmer by the gazebo
Say hello to two more people round the green

steps.text: The old oak hums at midnight. Sleep in your bed "Until the Shift" to get there quicker, or explore till then. Your choice!
It's the Shift! Walk into the portal by the old oak to cross over, then find out who's waiting on the other side.
A whole day in Galaxity! Dash, Rex, Tally and Zippy all have something to show you.
checklist: Pop 3 Gloops with your Star Popper
Look at Dash's gadget stall by the fountain
Skate Park: push along with Coach Rook
Finish a request from Tally's board
Find the lost watch on the Market fountain
Say hi to Zippy at the Lake Loop

steps.text: Everyone's whispering about a big golden Gloop out in the west fields, past the Market. Pop the Gloop King, then tell Dash!
checklist: Pop the Gloop King in the west fields

steps.text: What a day! Enjoy Galaxity till the Shift ends at 7 AM, when the portal pulls you home. Then find Nina.

reward.message: That was the first night of many. The portal opens again every midnight. (+10 sparkles)
